{"body":"Refs #420, oxc-project/oxc#30164.

oxfmt 0.80.0 and oxlint 1.95.0 ship `linux-x64-gnu` bindings built by GCC 15.2, which defaults to `-march=x86-64-v3`, so they contain BMI2 instructions. They crash with SIGILL on x86-64 CPUs without BMI2 (pre-Haswell).

| binding | BMI1/BMI2 instructions (objdump) | compiler |
| --- | --- | --- |
| @oxfmt/binding-linux-x64-gnu 0.80.0 | 150 | GCC 15.2 (Ubuntu 26.04) |
| @oxlint/binding-linux-x64-gnu 1.95.0 | 150 | GCC 15.2 (Ubuntu 26.04) |
| @oxfmt/binding-linux-x64-gnu 0.79.0 | 0 | GCC 13.3 (Ubuntu 24.04) |
| @oxlint/binding-linux-x64-gnu 1.94.0 | 0 | GCC 13.3 (Ubuntu 24.04) |

oxfmt is a runtime dependency (`src/tool/source-formatter.ts`), so this affects users, not only contributors.

- Pins `oxfmt` to 0.79.0 and `oxlint` to 1.94.0 (exact versions).
- Has Dependabot ignore only the broken versions. Newer releases will still be proposed, and each one should be checked for BMI2 instructions before merging.
- Adds a changelog entry.
